title: Playing for dances: tempo and the dancers' feet
summary: Dance tempos stayed fixed because the shuffling feet held a rushing drummer back, and good dancers influenced his playing.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Did you enjoy playing for dances?
Sure. Yeah, I used to enjoy (inaudible).
Doesn't it tend to affect the -- playing for dancing suddenly would affect things like tempos and so on --

When we were playing for dances I think the tempo was -- stayed pretty well fixed. Because the dancers keep it going. You can hear the feet shuffling and the feet -- and the -- of course if the tempo gets too fast the people -- if the drummer gets too fast, the people will still (inaudible) him down with the shuffle of them feet you know.
If he's one of them fast drummers that gets excited you know.
Yeah. Those people -- the sound of them feet will hold him back you know.
Uh-huh. Could it also be sometimes that you were watching some really good dancers while you were playing that it would make you play in a certain way.
